releases.notes:
# Changelog
- Added a built-in datapack to disable the Wither event and huge explosion events
- Added `drop_loots` function
- (Experimental)`spawn_mobs` now supports `vehicle_id` and `vehicle_nbt`
- Rewrite `add_particles`, now `particleId` just use as command(with nbt)
- Simplified `NbtHelper#parseParticleOptions`
- Cleaned up `LuckyEventExecutor`
- Added `zh_tw` translation (@Andy2088-TW, PR #18)
- Sorted events for future updates
- Added several new events
- Some fixes

# 总览Summary 本次更新加强了拓展功能。 The update added some addon features. ![screenshot](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bb092160-c56f-471e-b325-4699a098b817) `dev` is for dev purposes ## 声明Statement 本模组为个人学习项目，不保证稳定性。
This mod is a personal learning project, and its stability cannot be guaranteed.
# 依赖Dependencies | Support Version | Fabric Loader | Fabric API | File Name | |-----------------|---------------|------------|---------------------------------| | 1.21-1.21.1 | >=0.15.11 | >=0.102.1 | `MyLuckyBlock-1.2.0-1.21.jar` | | 1.21.1 | >=0.16.8 | >=0.110.0 | `MyLuckyBlock-1.2.0-1.21.1.jar` | | 1.21.2-1.21.3 | >=0.16.7 | >=0.106.1 | `MyLuckyBlock-1.2.0-1.21.2.jar` | | 1.21.4 | >=0.16.9 | >=0.111.0 | `MyLuckyBlock-1.2.0-1.21.4.jar` | | 1.21.5 | >=0.16.10 | >=0.115.2 | `MyLuckyBlock-1.2.0-25w05a.jar` | > `1.21.5`仅在`25w05a`与`25w06a`上测试过
> `1.21.5` has been tested on `25w05a` and `25w06a` only
# 贡献者Contributor - @Sycamore0 # 更改日志Changelog ## 中文 - 简化了事件加载逻辑 - 修改了部分addon功能，详情见release note下方 - 修改内置事件文件名 - 生物名称支持翻译（目前内置已完成部分翻译） - 幸运方块地图颜色改为粉色 ## English - Simplified event loading logic - Modified some addon features, see the release note below for details - Modified the built-in event file name - Support for translating biological names (currently, some translations of the built-in are completed) - Change the lucky block's map color to pink # 已知问题Issues ## 中文 - 1.21.5快照版本部分特殊物品失效 ## English - Some special items are invalid in the 1.21.5 snapshot version # 拓展Addons > 正在撰写文档
> Writing documentation
预计未来以添加功能为主，将减少对功能的调整。
Future updates are expected to focus on adding features, with fewer adjustments to existing features.
## Update ### 中文 - 在`create_explosions`中添加了`create_fire`来决定是否生成火焰 - 将`Structures`目录重命名为`structure` - 微调添加新的幸运方块时的选项 ### English - Added `create_fire` in `create_explosions` to determine whether to generate fire - Renamed the `structures` directory to `structure` - Tweaked the options when adding a new lucky block
